List runners: their machines, what the daemon knows of them, and what GitHub says.

## Usage

```console
$ rungar runners ls [flags]
```

## Flags

| Flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `--json` | Write JSON. |
| `--provider string` | Only the runners on this provider. |
| `--scale-set string` | Only this scale set's runners. |

## Global flags

| Flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `--socket string` | The daemon's socket (default `$RUNGAR_SOCKET`, or `/run/rungar/rungar.sock`). |
